gloss: good mood; high spirits; good humor

definitions.gloss: good mood; high spirits; good humor
definitions.explanation: A state of being in a cheerful, pleasant mood, often visibly so.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上機嫌|じょうきげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: My father came home in a great mood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{受|う}かって→受かる：19367_ukaru⟧、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上機嫌|じょうきげん}だった。
examples.english: Having passed the exam, she was in high spirits.

examples.japanese: {上機嫌|じょうきげん}な⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{頼|たの}み{事|ごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧なら⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧だ。
examples.english: If you want to ask the boss a favor, now's your chance while he's in a good mood.

notes:
Describes a visibly cheerful, pleasant mood. Can be used as a noun ({上機嫌|じょうきげん}だ) or as a pre-noun modifier ({上機嫌|じょうきげん}な). The ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ prefix elevates ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧ (mood, humor) to its positive extreme.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ — talk in good spirits
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ — cheerful face
- {上機嫌|じょうきげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ — sing happily
- ご{上機嫌|じょうきげん} — polite form, used in set phrases

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ — in a good mood; more neutral and everyday than {上機嫌|じょうきげん}, which implies a noticeably elevated level of cheerfulness
- ⟦{不機嫌|ふきげん}→不機嫌：17453_fukigen⟧ — bad mood; the opposite of {上機嫌|じょうきげん}
- ⟦ご{機嫌|きげん}→ご機嫌：25581_gokigen⟧ — mood (polite); also used in greetings like ⟦ご{機嫌|きげん}→ご機嫌：25581_gokigen⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧
